body.name: Unlabeled representative-set compression
body.construction: For each fixed \((t,\alpha,d)\), form the connectivity matrix on partitions \(\pi\) refining \(\alpha\), with entry one exactly when the join of a row partition and a completion partition connects every block of \(\alpha\).  After adding the charge indexed by \(H_t\), scan rows in nondecreasing exact rational cost and retain a minimum-cost \(\mathbb F_2\)-row basis.  Apply this reduction after each introduce, forget, and join operation, retaining the predecessor data and elimination pivots.
